title: Volunteer
copy: Volunteering at ILF is more than just being a part of India’s most vibrant literature festival. From pre-event duties and training to being part of Central India’s largest literature festival, every step is a learning experience. Volunteers give their time, energy, and enthusiasm, while creating memories that stay with them. It is a journey where we learn, grow, connect with people, and experience the world of literature from a different perspective. For us, volunteering at ILF is not just about contributing~it is about growing with the festival and becoming a part of its journey.
detail: Use the volunteer form to introduce yourself. The organising team will share the available roles and arrangements.
alt: Festival volunteers at ILF · client-selected photograph 158

title: Internship
copy: Interning at ILF is an experience where passion meets purpose. It is not just about being part of a literary festival, but about learning, contributing, and growing along the way. From communication and coordination to teamwork and responsibility, every task puts practical skills to the test. It demands dedication, respect for the work, and a willingness to learn from every experience. Above all, it is a celebration of the love for literature, people, ideas, and the conversations that bring them together.
detail: Apply through the internship form. Role details, duration and selection are confirmed by the festival team.
alt: Illustration of the festival team helping guests

title: Stall Booking
alt: Visitors browsing books at the ILF stall arena
copy: The Festival Stall Arena at ILF is a vibrant space where creativity, art, and entrepreneurship come together. It offers artists, creators, publishers, and independent brands an opportunity to showcase their work and connect with a diverse audience. More than just a marketplace, it is a platform to present unique ideas, artistic contributions, and creative expressions as part of India’s vibrant literary celebration. Booking a stall at ILF means becoming a part of an engaging community where creativity meets literature, conversation, and culture.
detail: Tell the team about your stall through the booking enquiry form. Availability and booking arrangements are confirmed directly.

title: Open Mic / Mai Bhi Kavi
copy:
अपनी कविता, कहानी और शब्दों को एक मंच देने से लेकर अपनी आवाज़ को लोगों तक पहुँचाने तक ~ ILF Open Mic/ Mai bhi kavi आपके लिए है।

आइए, अपने शब्दों को उड़ान दें, अपनी कहानी साझा करें और इस साहित्यिक उत्सव का हिस्सा बनें।

क्योंकि हर शब्द की अपनी एक कहानी है, बस उसे कहने के लिए एक मंच चाहिए।
detail: Apply using the Open Mic form. Google may ask you to sign in. If you cannot access it, contact the team using the help details below.
